content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Consolidated compensation: up to Rs. 27,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. HRA as applicable. Increment: 15% for every 3 years of experience, up to a maximum of 4 such revisions (that is, up to 12 years of experience). Nature of appointment: a temporary assignment in a purely time-bound research project. Tenure: 24 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in IIT Kharagpur Recruitment 2026 for Project Assistant - Technical?
faq.answer: Advertisement No. IIT/SRIC/R/UCP/2026/102 has 1 Project Assistant - Technical post, in the Department of Chemical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Technical post?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Technical post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Bachelors degree in science or a 3 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology. A B.Tech in Chemical Engineering, or research experience in Catalysis or Reactor Operation, is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Technical post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years, with age counted as on the last date of advertisement. The age rules may be relaxed if the candidate meets the sponsor agency's rules, if there are any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Technical post?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 27,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. HRA is paid as applicable, and there is a 15% increment for every 3 years of experience, up to 4 such revisions (up to 12 years of experience).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Technical post?
faq.answer: The notice sets the application fee at Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Technical post?
faq.answer: Apply online by 10 November 2026. The notice says that the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Technical post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is a temporary assignment in a purely time-bound research project. The tenure is 24 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Will every eligible applicant be called for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says that the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and meeting them does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Which agency funds the IIT Kharagpur Project Assistant - Technical project?
faq.answer: The project is sponsored by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF). Its title is "Sustainable Hydrogen From Hybrid Biogas Reforming Using Waste Derived Coe Resistant and Stable Catalysts with LCA Based Performance Assessment" (Project Code – R/UCP).
